title: Bazaar of Tabriz

buildingCutout.basis: The largest native market building outlines. Open courts and public streets are separately preserved.

terrainReference.basis: Original regional relief at the bazaar center, preserving the original grade from the source tiles.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap World Heritage relation 15355927, primary center precinct 493907311, surveyed building roofs, covered ways and named caravanserai courtyards.
mapIdentity.scope: Main UNESCO bazaar boundary with native surveyed covered paths, building polygons and named courtyard openings. The covered ways and open courts are preserved in the modeled roof areas.

note: Original city terrain and official nomination descriptions of brick rasta vaults, domes, timber shopfronts, stone bases and typical six-to-fourteen-metre heights. The exact 2007 photograph guides the brick ribs, pointed profile and openings.
